name: Catalyst
例文: The new law acted as a catalyst for social change.
例文翻译: 新法律充当了社会变革的催化剂。

name: Arid
例文: Few plants can thrive in such an arid climate.
例文翻译: 很少有植物能在如此干旱的气候中茁壮成长。

name: Bolster
例文: The latest data helped to bolster the scientist's theory.
例文翻译: 最新的数据有助于支持科学家的理论。

name: Albeit
例文: It was an amazing discovery albeit a very accidental one.
例文翻译: 那是一个惊人的发现，尽管非常偶然。

name: Tectonic
例文: Tectonic plate movements are responsible for mountain building.
例文翻译: 地壳板块运动是山脉形成的原因。

name: Implicit
例文: There was an implicit agreement that the project would be funded.
例文翻译: 大家默契地认为该项目会获得资助。

name: Delineate
例文: The report clearly delineates the boundaries of the research.
例文翻译: 该报告清楚地勾勒出了研究的边界。

name: Accretion
例文: The accretion of cosmic dust led to the formation of the planet.
例文翻译: 宇宙尘埃的积聚导致了行星的形成。

name: Fabricate
例文: He was accused of trying to fabricate evidence for his case.
例文翻译: 他被指控试图为自己的案件伪造证据。

name: Erode
例文: Acid rain can slowly erode the surface of ancient monuments.
例文翻译: 酸雨会缓慢侵蚀古代纪念碑的表面。

name: Hypothesis
例文: Scientists are working to test the initial hypothesis.
例文翻译: 科学家们正致力于测试最初的假设。

name: Compel
例文: The drought compelled many farmers to leave their land.
例文翻译: 干旱迫使许多农民离开他们的土地。

name: Aesthetic
例文: The building combines modern technology with traditional aesthetics.
例文翻译: 这栋建筑将现代技术与传统美学相结合。

name: Attribute
例文: She attributes her success to years of hard work.
例文翻译: 她将成功归功于多年的努力。

name: Inherent
例文: There are inherent risks in any deep-sea exploration.
例文翻译: 任何深海探索都存在固有风险。

name: Paradigm
例文: This discovery represents a paradigm shift in physics.
例文翻译: 这一发现代表了物理学的一个范式转移。

name: Empirical
例文: The theory is supported by a wealth of empirical data.
例文翻译: 该理论得到了丰富的实证数据支持。

name: Substantial
例文: The project required a substantial amount of time and money.
例文翻译: 该项目需要大量的时间和金钱。

name: Deteriorate
例文: The condition of the ruins deteriorated rapidly after the storm.
例文翻译: 风暴过后，遗迹的状况迅速恶化。

name: Amplify
例文: Social media can amplify the impact of a news story.
例文翻译: 社交媒体可以放大新闻故事的影响。

name: Autonomous
例文: The university is an autonomous institution.
例文翻译: 这所大学是一个自治机构。

name: Bias
例文: The researcher was criticized for her cultural bias.
例文翻译: 这位研究人员因其文化偏见而受到批评。

name: Coherent
例文: The witness gave a coherent account of the accident.
例文翻译: 证人对事故给出了连贯的陈述。

name: Diffuse
例文: The scent of pine trees diffused through the forest.
例文翻译: 松树的香味在森林中弥漫开来。

name: Elite
例文: The program is designed for the country's elite students.
例文翻译: 该计划是为该国的精英学生设计的。

name: Feasible
例文: The professor asked if the research plan was feasible.
例文翻译: 教授询问该研究计划是否可行。

name: Hierarchy
例文: The social hierarchy of ancient Rome was very strict.
例文翻译: 古罗马的社会等级制度非常严格。

name: Illuminate
例文: The study helps to illuminate the causes of the revolution.
例文翻译: 这项研究有助于阐明革命的原因。

name: Incentive
例文: The government offers tax incentives to small businesses.
例文翻译: 政府为小企业提供税收激励。

name: Manifest
例文: The symptoms of the disease manifest in several ways.
例文翻译: 这种疾病的症状以多种方式表现出来。

name: Notable
例文: The city is notable for its unique architecture.
例文翻译: 这座城市以其独特的建筑而闻名。

name: Obscure
例文: The meaning of the poem is somewhat obscure.
例文翻译: 这首诗的意义有些晦涩。

name: Potential
例文: The new technology has the potential to transform the industry.
例文翻译: 这项新技术具有改变行业的潜力。

name: Refine
例文: The theory was refined after years of observation.
例文翻译: 该理论在经过多年的观察后得到了完善。

name: Significant
例文: There has been a significant increase in online sales.
例文翻译: 在线销售额有了显著增长。

name: Transform
例文: Technology has transformed the way we communicate.
例文翻译: 技术改变了我们的沟通方式。

name: Underlie
例文: Economic issues underlie many social problems.
例文翻译: 经济问题是许多社会问题的基础。

name: Validate
例文: The results were used to validate the previous findings.
例文翻译: 这些结果被用于验证之前的发现。

name: Widespread
例文: There is widespread concern about air pollution.
例文翻译: 人们对空气污染存在广泛的担忧。

name: Yield
例文: The experimental farm yielded a bumper crop.
例文翻译: 实验农场获得了大丰收。

name: Abundant
例文: The island is abundant in natural resources.
例文翻译: 这个岛屿自然资源丰富。

name: Allocate
例文: The committee decided to allocate more time to the discussion.
例文翻译: 委员会决定分配更多的时间进行讨论。

name: Ambiguous
例文: The teacher's instructions were rather ambiguous.
例文翻译: 老师的指示相当模糊。

name: Analogy
例文: He made an analogy between the brain and a computer.
例文翻译: 他把大脑比作电脑。

name: Apparatus
例文: The lab is equipped with the latest scientific apparatus.
例文翻译: 实验室配备了最新的科学仪器。

name: Arid
例文: Cacti are adapted to live in arid regions.
例文翻译: 仙人掌适应在干旱地区生活。

name: Assimilate
例文: It takes time for new students to assimilate all the rules.
例文翻译: 新生需要时间来吸收所有的规则。

name: Bolster
例文: The good news bolstered the team's morale.
例文翻译: 好消息增强了团队的士气。

name: Cease
例文: The rain finally ceased after three days.
例文翻译: 雨在三天后终于停了。

name: Chronological
例文: The events are listed in chronological order.
例文翻译: 事件按时间顺序排列。

name: Coincide
例文: The exhibition coincides with the university's anniversary.
例文翻译: 展览恰逢大学校庆。

name: Collaborate
例文: Students were encouraged to collaborate on the project.
例文翻译: 鼓励学生在项目上进行合作。

name: Complex
例文: The human brain is an incredibly complex organ.
例文翻译: 大脑是一个极其复杂的器官。

name: Comprehensive
例文: The textbook provides a comprehensive guide to biology.
例文翻译: 该教科书提供了全面的生物学指南。

name: Concede
例文: He had to concede that his argument was flawed.
例文翻译: 他不得不承认他的论证有缺陷。

name: Concrete
例文: The police have no concrete evidence against him.
例文翻译: 警方没有针对他的具体证据。

name: Confirm
例文: The doctor confirmed that the surgery was successful.
例文翻译: 医生确认手术成功。

name: Context
例文: You need to look at the words in their historical context.
例文翻译: 你需要结合历史背景来看这些词。

name: Contradict
例文: His actions contradict his words.
例文翻译: 他的行为与言语相矛盾。

name: Contrast
例文: The cold weather was a sharp contrast to the heat of July.
例文翻译: 寒冷的天气与七月的酷热形成了鲜明的对比。

name: Controversy
例文: The new movie caused a lot of controversy.
例文翻译: 这部新电影引起了很多争议。

name: Converge
例文: The two paths converge at the edge of the forest.
例文翻译: 这两条路在森林边缘汇合。

name: Core
例文: The core of the issue is a lack of trust.
例文翻译: 问题的核心是缺乏信任。

name: Crude
例文: The factory processes crude oil into fuel.
例文翻译: 工厂将原油加工成燃料。

name: Cumulative
例文: The cumulative weight of the snow broke the roof.
例文翻译: 雪的累积重量压塌了屋顶。

name: Data
例文: The data shows that temperatures are rising.
例文翻译: 数据表明气温正在上升。

name: Decay
例文: The old wooden house has started to decay.
例文翻译: 那座旧木屋已经开始腐烂。

name: Deliberate
例文: The attack was a deliberate act of violence.
例文翻译: 这次袭击是一次蓄意的暴力行为。

name: Dense
例文: The plane disappeared into a dense cloud.
例文翻译: 飞机消失在浓云中。

name: Depict
例文: The novel depicts life in rural England.
例文翻译: 这部小说描写了英国农村的生活。

name: Deplete
例文: The forest resources are being depleted rapidly.
例文翻译: 森林资源正在迅速枯竭。

name: Deposit
例文: The river leaves a deposit of sand on the banks.
例文翻译: 河流在岸边留下沙子沉积物。

name: Derive
例文: Many English words are derived from Latin.
例文翻译: 许多英语单词源于拉丁语。

name: Detect
例文: The system can detect small changes in temperature.
例文翻译: 该系统可以探测到微小的温度变化。

name: Deviate
例文: The path deviates from the main road.
例文翻译: 这条小路偏离了主路。

name: Diagram
例文: The teacher used a diagram to explain the process.
例文翻译: 老师用图表来解释这个过程。

name: Diminish
例文: His influence has diminished over the years.
例文翻译: 他的影响力这些年来减弱了。

name: Discrete
例文: The data is sorted into discrete categories.
例文翻译: 数据被分为离散的类别。

name: Displace
例文: The war displaced thousands of people.
例文翻译: 战争使成千上万的人流离失所。

name: Diverse
例文: The university has a very diverse student body.
例文翻译: 这所大学的学生群体非常多样化。

name: Domestic
例文: The company focuses on the domestic market.
例文翻译: 公司专注于国内市场。

name: Dramatic
例文: There has been a dramatic fall in the price of oil.
例文翻译: 油价出现了剧烈下跌。

name: Dynamic
例文: The global economy is a dynamic system.
例文翻译: 全球经济是一个动态的系统。

name: Eclipse
例文: A total eclipse of the sun is a rare event.
例文翻译: 日全食是一种罕见的事件。

name: Efficiency
例文: The new engine has a higher fuel efficiency.
例文翻译: 新发动机的燃油效率更高。

name: Eliminate
例文: We must eliminate all potential risks.
例文翻译: 我们必须消除所有潜在风险。

name: Eloquent
例文: The president gave an eloquent speech.
例文翻译: 总统发表了动人的演讲。

name: Embody
例文: The statue embodies the spirit of freedom.
例文翻译: 这座雕像体现了自由的精神。

name: Emerge
例文: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
例文翻译: 太阳从云层后面出现了。

name: Emission
例文: Cars produce harmful carbon emissions.
例文翻译: 汽车产生有害的碳排放。

name: Emphasize
例文: The report emphasizes the need for more education.
例文翻译: 报告强调了需要更多教育。

name: Enable
例文: Technology enables us to work from anywhere.
例文翻译: 技术使我们能够在任何地方工作。

name: Encounter
例文: We encountered many obstacles during the hike.
例文翻译: 我们在徒步旅行中遇到了许多障碍。

name: Endure
例文: The ancient ruins have endured for centuries.
例文翻译: 古代遗迹已存在了几个世纪。

name: Enhance
例文: The new software will enhance your productivity.
例文翻译: 新软件将提高你的工作效率。

name: Ensure
例文: Please ensure that all the lights are turned off.
例文翻译: 请确保所有的灯都关掉了。

name: Entity
例文: The two companies are separate legal entities.
例文翻译: 这两家公司是独立的法人实体。

name: Equilibrium
例文: The market will reach an equilibrium eventually.
例文翻译: 市场最终会达到平衡。

name: Equivalent
例文: One unit is equivalent to two hours of study.
例文翻译: 一个学分相当于两个小时的学习。

name: Erratic
例文: His behavior has been very erratic lately.
例文翻译: 他最近的行为一直很不稳定。

name: Establish
例文: The school was established in 1850.
例文翻译: 这所学校建于1850年。

name: Estimate
例文: The cost of the repairs is estimated at $500.
例文翻译: 修理费用估计为500美元。

name: Evaluate
例文: The judges will evaluate each performance.
例文翻译: 评委将评估每一场表演。

name: Evident
例文: It was evident that she was unhappy.
例文翻译: 显而易见她很不开心。

name: Evolution
例文: The evolution of the species took millions of years.
例文翻译: 物种的进化花了数百万年。

name: Exceed
例文: The weight of the luggage exceeds the limit.
例文翻译: 行李重量超过了限制。

name: Exhibit
例文: The museum will exhibit new paintings.
例文翻译: 博物馆将展出新画作。

name: Expand
例文: The company plans to expand its business to Asia.
例文翻译: 公司计划将其业务扩张到亚洲。

name: Explicit
例文: The teacher gave explicit instructions.
例文翻译: 老师给出了明确的指示。

name: Exploit
例文: We must learn how to exploit renewable energy.
例文翻译: 我们必须学会如何开发可再生能源。

name: Extract
例文: Oil is extracted from the ground.
例文翻译: 石油是从地下提取出来的。

name: Facilitate
例文: Modern technology facilitates communication.
例文翻译: 现代技术促进了沟通。

name: Faculty
例文: He is a member of the university faculty.
例文翻译: 他是大学教职员的一员。

name: Feasible
例文: We need to find a feasible solution to the problem.
例文翻译: 我们需要找到一个解决问题的可行方案。

name: Finite
例文: The Earth has finite natural resources.
例文翻译: 地球的自然资源是有限的。

name: Flexible
例文: Working hours are very flexible in this office.
例文翻译: 这个办公室的办公时间非常灵活。

name: Fluctuate
例文: The price of gold fluctuates every day.
例文翻译: 金钱的价格每天都在波动。

name: Formulate
例文: They are working to formulate a new plan.
例文翻译: 他们正致力于制定一个新计划。

name: Fragment
例文: Archaeologists found fragments of ancient pottery.
例文翻译: 考古学家发现了古代陶器的碎片。

name: Framework
例文: The law provides a framework for environmental protection.
例文翻译: 法律为环境保护提供了一个框架。

name: Frequency
例文: The frequency of earthquakes is increasing.
例文翻译: 地震的频率正在增加。

name: Fundamental
例文: Education is a fundamental human right.
例文翻译: 教育是一项基本人权。

name: Generate
例文: The wind turbines generate electricity.
例文翻译: 风力涡轮机发电。

name: Genuine
例文: The painting is a genuine Picasso.
例文翻译: 这幅画是毕加索的真迹。

name: Global
例文: Climate change is a global issue.
例文翻译: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

name: Grade
例文: She received a passing grade on the test.
例文翻译: 她考试及格了。

name: Grant
例文: The government provided a research grant.
例文翻译: 政府提供了一笔研究拨款。

name: Gravity
例文: The earth's gravity pulls objects toward the center.
例文翻译: 地球引力将物体向中心拉。

name: Habitat
例文: The forest is the natural habitat of many animals.
例文翻译: 森林是许多动物的天然栖息地。

name: Hazard
例文: Toxic waste is a hazard to human health.
例文翻译: 有毒废物对人类健康是一个危害。

name: Hierarchy
例文: The company has a clear management hierarchy.
例文翻译: 公司有明确的管理等级制度。

name: Highlight
例文: The report highlights the main problems.
例文翻译: 报告强调了主要问题。

name: Incentive
例文: The prize acted as an incentive for the students.
例文翻译: 奖品对学生起到了激励作用。

name: Incorporate
例文: The new design incorporates several changes.
例文翻译: 新设计包含了几项改动。

name: Indicate
例文: A red light indicates that the machine is on.
例文翻译: 红灯表明机器已开启。

name: Innovation
例文: The company is known for its technical innovation.
例文翻译: 该公司以其技术创新而闻名。

name: Insight
例文: The book gives insight into human nature.
例文翻译: 这本书提供了对人性的洞察。

name: Inspect
例文: The bridge is inspected regularly for safety.
例文翻译: 大桥定期进行安全检查。

name: Integrate
例文: The new system integrates all the data.
例文翻译: 新系统整合了所有数据。

name: Integrity
例文: He is a man of great personal integrity.
例文翻译: 他是一个非常有诚信的人。

name: Intense
例文: The heat in the desert can be very intense.
例文翻译: 沙漠里的酷热可能非常剧烈。

name: Interact
例文: The students are encouraged to interact with each other.
例文翻译: 鼓励学生相互互动。

name: Interpret
例文: It's difficult to interpret the meaning of the poem.
例文翻译: 很难解释这首诗的意义。

name: Interval
例文: The bells ring at ten-minute intervals.
例文翻译: 铃声每隔十分钟响一次。

name: Intrinsic
例文: Music is an intrinsic part of the culture.
例文翻译: 音乐是该文化本质的一部分。

name: Isolate
例文: The patient was isolated to prevent infection.
例文翻译: 病人被隔离以防止感染。

name: Issue
例文: The main issue is a lack of funding.
例文翻译: 主要问题是缺乏资金。

name: Journal
例文: He publishes his research in scientific journals.
例文翻译: 他在科学期刊上发表研究成果。

name: Label
例文: Each bottle was marked with a clear label.
例文翻译: 每个瓶子都贴有清晰的标签。

name: Layer
例文: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
例文翻译: 蛋糕有三层巧克力。

name: Legal
例文: You should seek legal advice.
例文翻译: 你应该寻求法律建议。

name: Link
例文: There is a clear link between poverty and crime.
例文翻译: 贫困与犯罪之间有明显的联系。

name: Logic
例文: There is a certain logic to her argument.
例文翻译: 她的论证有一定的逻辑。

name: Maintain
例文: It's important to maintain a healthy weight.
例文翻译: 保持健康的体重很重要。

name: Manifest
例文: The disease manifests itself in a skin rash.
例文翻译: 这种疾病表现为皮疹。

name: Mechanism
例文: The clock mechanism is very delicate.
例文翻译: 钟表的机制非常精致。

name: Media
例文: The event was covered by the national media.
例文翻译: 国家媒体报道了这一事件。

name: Mental
例文: Mental health is as important as physical health.
例文翻译: 心理健康和身体健康一样重要。

name: Migrate
例文: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
例文翻译: 许多鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。

name: Military
例文: The country has a large military force.
例文翻译: 这个国家拥有一支庞大的军事力量。

name: Minor
例文: The pilot made some minor adjustments.
例文翻译: 飞行员做了一些微调。

name: Modify
例文: The software was modified to work on tablets.
例文翻译: 软件经过修改以在平板电脑上运行。

name: Monitor
例文: The system monitors the building's temperature.
例文翻译: 系统监控建筑物的温度。

name: Mutual
例文: The two countries have a mutual goal.
例文翻译: 两国有一个共同的目标。

name: Negative
例文: Smoking has a negative effect on your health.
例文翻译: 吸烟对你的健康有负面影响。

name: Network
例文: The company has a global network of offices.
例文翻译: 公司拥有全球办公网络。

name: Neutral
例文: Switzerland remained neutral during the war.
例文翻译: 瑞士在战争期间保持中立。

name: Nevertheless
例文: It was late; nevertheless
例文翻译: we finished the work.
column5: 很晚了；尽管如此，我们还是完成了工作。

name: Norm
例文: Working from home has become the norm.
例文翻译: 在家办公已成为常态。

name: Objective
例文: Our main objective is to reduce costs.
例文翻译: 我们的主要目标是降低成本。

name: Observe
例文: Scientists observe the movements of stars.
例文翻译: 科学家观察星星的运动。

name: Obtain
例文: You must obtain permission before leaving.
例文翻译: 离开前必须获得许可。

name: Occupy
例文: The enemy army occupied the city.
例文翻译: 敌军占领了这座城市。

name: Occur
例文: The accident occurred yesterday afternoon.
例文翻译: 事故发生在昨天下午。

name: Option
例文: You have the option to study abroad.
例文翻译: 你可以选择出国留学。

name: Outcome
例文: The outcome of the meeting was positive.
例文翻译: 会议的结果是积极的。

name: Output
例文: The factory's output has increased this year.
例文翻译: 工厂的产量今年增加了。

name: Passive
例文: Students should not be passive in class.
例文翻译: 学生在课堂上不应是被动的。

name: Perceive
例文: He perceived a change in the atmosphere.
例文翻译: 他察觉到气氛发生了变化。

name: Perspective
例文: Try to see the problem from my perspective.
例文翻译: 试着从我的角度来看这个问题。

name: Phase
例文: The project is in its final phase.
例文翻译: 项目处于最后阶段。

name: Phenomenon
例文: Snow is a common weather phenomenon.
例文翻译: 雪是一种常见的天气现象。

name: Philosophy
例文: He studied philosophy at the university.
例文翻译: 他在大学学习哲学。

name: Physical
例文: The physical world consists of matter and energy.
例文翻译: 物理世界由物质和能量组成。

name: Potential
例文: She has the potential to be a great artist.
例文翻译: 她有成为伟大艺术家的潜力。

name: Precise
例文: We need precise measurements for the experiment.
例文翻译: 实验需要精确的测量。

name: Predict
例文: It's hard to predict the future.
例文翻译: 很难预测未来。

name: Primary
例文: The primary goal is to save lives.
例文翻译: 主要目标是挽救生命。

name: Principle
例文: He is a man of strong moral principles.
例文翻译: 他是一个有很强道德原则的人。

name: Prior
例文: No prior knowledge of the subject is required.
例文翻译: 不需要该学科的预备知识。

name: Priority
例文: Education is our top priority.
例文翻译: 教育是我们的首要任务。

name: Process
例文: The process of making wine is complicated.
例文翻译: 酿酒的过程很复杂。

name: Professional
例文: He is a professional musician.
例文翻译: 他是一位专业音乐家。

name: Profit
例文: The company made a small profit this year.
例文翻译: 公司今年赚了点小利。

name: Promote
例文: The goal is to promote world peace.
例文翻译: 目标是促进世界和平。

name: Proportion
例文: A large proportion of the students are foreign.
例文翻译: 很大一部分学生是外国人。

name: Prospect
例文: The job prospects are good in this field.
例文翻译: 这个领域的工作前景很好。

name: Psychology
例文: She is studying child psychology.
例文翻译: 她正在研究儿童心理学。

name: Purchase
例文: You can purchase tickets online.
例文翻译: 你可以在网上买票。

name: Pursue
例文: He decided to pursue a career in law.
例文翻译: 他决定从事法律职业。

name: Range
例文: The store sells a wide range of goods.
例文翻译: 这家商店销售各种各样的商品。

name: Ratio
例文: The ratio of boys to girls is two to one.
例文翻译: 男女生的比例是二比一。

name: Rational
例文: There must be a rational explanation.
例文翻译: 一定有一个合理的解释。

name: React
例文: How did he react to the news?
例文翻译: 他对这个消息有什么反应？

name: Recover
例文: He is recovering from a serious illness.
例文翻译: 他正在重病康复中。

name: Regulate
例文: The government regulates the industry.
例文翻译: 政府管制该行业。

name: Reject
例文: The proposal was rejected by the board.
例文翻译: 提议被董事会拒绝了。

name: Relevant
例文: Please provide all relevant information.
例文翻译: 请提供所有相关信息。

name: Reliable
例文: He is a very reliable employee.
例文翻译: 他是一位非常可靠的雇员。

name: Rely
例文: We rely on the sun for light and heat.
例文翻译: 我们依靠太阳获得光和热。

name: Remove
例文: Please remove your hat inside.
例文翻译: 请在室内摘掉帽子。

name: Require
例文: The job requires a lot of travel.
例文翻译: 这份工作要求经常出差。

name: Respond
例文: The company responded quickly to the crisis.
例文翻译: 公司对危机做出了迅速回应。

name: Reverse
例文: The decision was reversed after an appeal.
例文翻译: 在上诉后，决定被扭转了。

name: Role
例文: The teacher plays a key role in education.
例文翻译: 教师在教育中起着关键作用。

name: Schedule
例文: I have a very busy schedule today.
例文翻译: 我今天的日程非常忙。

name: Scope
例文: The scope of the investigation is very broad.
例文翻译: 调查的范围非常广。

name: Section
例文: The report is divided into four sections.
例文翻译: 报告分为四个部分。

name: Secure
例文: The building is very secure.
例文翻译: 这栋建筑非常安全。

name: Select
例文: Please select the best answer.
例文翻译: 请选择最佳答案。

name: Sequence
例文: The numbers are in a specific sequence.
例文翻译: 这些数字按特定顺序排列。

name: Shift
例文: There has been a shift in public opinion.
例文翻译: 公众舆论发生了转变。

name: Similar
例文: The two cars are very similar.
例文翻译: 这两辆车非常相似。

name: Site
例文: The site was chosen for the new school.
例文翻译: 该地点被选为新学校的地址。

name: Source
例文: The sun is our main source of energy.
例文翻译: 太阳是我们主要的能量来源。

name: Stable
例文: The patient's condition is stable.
例文翻译: 病人的情况稳定。

name: Status
例文: What is the current status of the project?
例文翻译: 项目的当前状态是什么？

name: Structure
例文: The building has a solid structure.
例文翻译: 这栋建筑结构牢固。

name: Submit
例文: Please submit your report by Friday.
例文翻译: 请在周五前提交报告。

name: Summary
例文: The report provides a summary of the findings.
例文翻译: 报告提供了调查结果的总结。

name: Survey
例文: We conducted a survey of local residents.
例文翻译: 我们对当地居民进行了调查。

name: Sustain
例文: The company managed to sustain its growth.
例文翻译: 公司成功维持了增长。

name: Symbol
例文: The dove is a symbol of peace.
例文翻译: 鸽子是和平的象征。

name: Technical
例文: The project requires technical expertise.
例文翻译: 该项目需要技术专长。

name: Technology
例文: Technology has changed our lives.
例文翻译: 技术改变了我们的生活。

name: Temporary
例文: The closure of the road is temporary.
例文翻译: 道路封闭是暂时的。

name: Trend
例文: There is a trend toward healthy eating.
例文翻译: 有一种健康饮食的趋势。

name: Unique
例文: Every snowflake is unique.
例文翻译: 每一片雪花都是独特的。

name: Unit
例文: The meter is a unit of length.
例文翻译: 米是长度单位。

name: Urban
例文: More people are moving to urban areas.
例文翻译: 更多的人正搬往城市地区。

name: Variable
例文: Temperature is an important variable.
例文翻译: 温度是一个重要的变量。

name: Variation
例文: There is a lot of variation in the weather.
例文翻译: 天气有很多变化。

name: Volume
例文: The library has a large volume of books.
例文翻译: 图书馆藏书量巨大。

name: Yield
例文: The investment yielded a high return.
例文翻译: 这项投资带来了高回报。
